image_transform: MNC [0,z,x] array flipped in z for superior-up display; no registration added
contrast: Linear window between positive-voxel percentiles 1 and 99; source intensity unchanged in MNC file
licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; all BigBrain derivatives in this directory use the same license
attribution: BigBrain: Amunts et al., McGill / Forschungszentrum Jülich. Manual cortical annotations: Wagstyl et al. (2020). Credits and original licence retained.
surface_intersections: Seven left cortical boundary surfaces, original triangles clipped at y=plane_y_mm with source mask==1; no fitted alignment
limits: This aligned section is sampled at 20 micrometres, not the original 5 micrometre rescan
Manual labels cover selected regions only; unlabelled pixels are not absence of a cortical layer
Surface intersections are reconstructed boundaries; overlap is a comparison, not proof of independent validation
No synapses, axonal tracing, neuronal activity or biological transmission delays provided
